# instudia — Complete Institute & Curriculum Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive knowledge file for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI search engines, and web crawlers detailing instudia's academic programs, course curricula, campus facilities, and student services. ISO 9001:2015 certified & MSME registered.

## Overview
- Institute Name: instudia
- Tagline: Skill is the only unfair advantage.
- Location: First Floor, Vikiye Center, Opposite Notun Bosti Gate, Fellowship Colony, Dimapur, Nagaland 797112, India
- Accreditation: ISO 9001:2015 Certified & MSME Registered Skill Development Institute
- Phone: +91 87985 87779
- Email: instudia.nagaland@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.instudianagaland.com
- Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST

## Mission & Vision
instudia is dedicated to closing the technical skills gap in Northeast India by providing project-based, industry-aligned training programs. Combining 1-on-1 mentorship, modern computer labs, and real-world portfolio building, instudia equips students and professionals for high-demand careers in technology, design, finance, and office management.

---

## Complete Academic Offerings & Detailed Curricula

### 1. Diploma in Computer Applications (DCA)
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/diploma-in-computer-applications
- Category: Technology / Foundational Computing
- Duration: 6 Months
- Eligibility: Grade 6 and Above / Open to all
- Overview: Comprehensive foundational diploma covering computer basics, office productivity, accounting foundations, programming, and AI tools.
- Key Modules:
  1. Computer Fundamentals: Hardware architecture, operating systems, file management, software installation.
  2. MS Office Suite: MS Word (formatting, mail merge), MS Excel (functions, charts, pivot tables), MS PowerPoint (presentations).
  3. Internet & Email: Online security, web protocols, professional email etiquette, cloud storage.
  4. Tally Fundamentals: Accounting fundamentals, ledger creation, voucher entry, balance sheets.
  5. Python Programming: Basic syntax, control flow, loops, and simple scripts.
  6. AI Basics: Understanding generative AI, prompts, study companions, and productivity tools.
  7. Capstone Assessment: Practical exam and project submission.

### 2. Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications (PGDCA)
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/pgdca
- Category: Technology / Advanced Diploma
- Duration: 12 Months
- Eligibility: Graduation in any discipline
- Overview: Year-long intensive diploma designed for graduates aiming to enter IT administration, software development, and modern office systems.
- Key Modules:
  1. Advanced Operating Systems and Office Automation.
  2. Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) & SQL.
  3. Object-Oriented Programming and Scripting (C++/Python).
  4. Web Design & Internet Technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  5. Accounting and Enterprise ERP Systems (Tally Prime).
  6. Practical Project Development & Viva Voce.

### 3. Fullstack Web Development
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/fullstack-web-development
- Category: Software Engineering
- Duration: 3-6 Months
- Overview: Complete web development roadmap taking learners from frontend styling to production backend architecture and database management.
- Key Modules:
  1. Frontend Architecture: HTML5 semantic tags, CSS3, modern Flexbox & Grid, responsive layouts.
  2. Modern JavaScript: ES6+ syntax, asynchronous programming, Promises, Fetch API, DOM manipulation.
  3. React Framework: Components, props, state hooks, routing, context API, Tailwind CSS.
  4. Backend Engineering: Node.js runtime, Express.js REST API creation, middleware, authentication (JWT).
  5. Databases: MongoDB / PostgreSQL, schemas, queries, data relationships.
  6. Version Control & Deployment: Git/GitHub, Vercel, Render, CI/CD basic deployments.

### 4. Programming with Python
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/python
- Category: Software Engineering
- Duration: 1-3 Months
- Overview: Comprehensive introduction to Python for beginners, automation enthusiasts, and aspiring data analysts.
- Key Modules:
  1. Python Basics: Variables, data types, string manipulation, operators.
  2. Data Structures: Lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, comprehensions.
  3. Control Flow: Conditionals, loops, error handling, custom functions.
  4. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Classes, objects, inheritance, encapsulation.
  5. File I/O & Automation: File reading/writing, web scraping, automation scripts.
  6. Mini-Projects: Interactive command-line games, budget trackers, automated utilities.

### 5. Frontend Development
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/frontend-development
- Category: Software Engineering
- Duration: 2-3 Months
- Overview: Specialized focus on modern client-side user interfaces, responsive design, and React development.
- Key Modules:
  1. Semantic HTML & CSS3 modern features.
  2. Tailwind CSS and utility-first design systems.
  3. JavaScript ES6+ deeply: array methods, event loop, APIs.
  4. React.js: Components, hooks, custom hooks, state management, SPA routing.

### 6. Backend Development
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/backend-development
- Category: Software Engineering
- Duration: 2-3 Months
- Overview: Server-side architecture, API engineering, database design, and secure authentication.
- Key Modules:
  1. Server Fundamentals with Node.js and Express.
  2. RESTful API Design & Best Practices.
  3. Relational & NoSQL Database integration (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  4. Authentication, Authorization, Role-Based Access Control, JWT.
  5. Security best practices: CORS, rate limiting, sanitization.

### 7. Graphic Designing
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/graphic-designing
- Category: Creative & Interface Design
- Duration: 3-6 Months
- Overview: Visual branding, digital illustration, and print media design using industry-standard tools.
- Key Modules:
  1. Design Theory: Color harmony, typography, visual hierarchy, grid systems.
  2. Adobe Photoshop: Photo manipulation, retouching, social media creatives, banner ads.
  3. Adobe Illustrator: Vector graphics, logo creation, mascot design, brand identity kits.
  4. CorelDRAW: Print layout, packaging design, brochures, flex printing formats.
  5. Portfolio Development: Creating a client-ready design portfolio.

### 8. UI/UX Designing
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/ui-ux-designing
- Category: Creative & Interface Design
- Duration: 3 Months
- Overview: User experience research, wireframing, high-fidelity UI design, and interactive prototyping.
- Key Modules:
  1. Design Thinking & UX Research: User personas, journey mapping, empathy maps.
  2. Information Architecture & Wireframing in Figma.
  3. UI Design: Typography, color palettes, atomic design systems, component libraries.
  4. Interactive Prototyping: Micro-interactions, animations, smart animate.
  5. Usability Testing & Developer Handoff.

### 9. Tally Prime with Accounting
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/tally
- Category: Accounting, Finance & Business
- Duration: 1-2 Months
- Overview: Practical corporate and small business bookkeeping using India's standard accounting software.
- Key Modules:
  1. Accounting Principles: Double-entry bookkeeping, debit/credit rules, financial terms.
  2. Company Creation & Ledger Management in Tally Prime.
  3. Voucher Entries: Payment, receipt, contra, journal, sales, purchase vouchers.
  4. Inventory Management: Stock groups, stock items, units of measure.
  5. Banking & Reconciliation: Bank statements, cheque register, auto-reconciliation.
  6. Financial Reports: Profit & loss statements, balance sheets, trial balance.

### 10. GST Compliance & Certification
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/gst
- Category: Accounting, Finance & Business
- Duration: 1-2 Months
- Overview: Goods and Services Tax computation, invoicing rules, and return filing procedures.
- Key Modules:
  1. GST Framework: CGST, SGST, IGST, UTGST structure in India.
  2. Input Tax Credit (ITC) mechanism and eligibility rules.
  3. Invoicing, E-way Bills, and Delivery Challans.
  4. Return Filing: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns.
  5. Tax reconciliation in Tally Prime.

### 11. Advanced Excel
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/advance-excel
- Category: Accounting, Finance & Business
- Duration: 1 Month
- Overview: Data analysis, business modeling, complex lookup formulas, and automated dashboards in Microsoft Excel.
- Key Modules:
  1. Advanced Formulas: XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, nested IF/IFS, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS.
  2. Data Cleaning & Text Manipulation functions.
  3. Pivot Tables & Pivot Charts: Data grouping, slicers, calculated fields.
  4. Interactive Executive Dashboards and data visualization.
  5. Data Validation, Conditional Formatting, and Macro basics.

### 12. Business Intelligence using Power BI
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/buisness-intelligence-using-powerbi
- Category: Accounting, Finance & Business
- Duration: 1-2 Months
- Overview: Extracting insights, building data models, and publishing interactive dashboards using Microsoft Power BI.
- Key Modules:
  1. Power Query: Data import, ETL transformations, merging, appending queries.
  2. Data Modeling: Star schema, relationships, cardinalities.
  3. DAX Calculations: Measures, calculated columns, time intelligence functions.
  4. Report Design: Slicers, KPI cards, drill-throughs, custom visuals.

### 13. Data Analytics
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/data-analytics
- Category: Technology
- Overview: Modern data analytics combining SQL, Python (Pandas/NumPy), and business visualization tools.

### 14. Learn DevOps & Cloud Services
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/learn-devops-cloud-services
- Category: Technology
- Overview: Containerization with Docker, cloud fundamentals, CI/CD pipeline automation, and server monitoring.

### 15. Hardware & Networking
- URL: https://www.instudianagaland.com/courses/hardware-networking
- Category: Technology
- Overview: Motherboard architecture, PC assembly, LAN configuration, TCP/IP basics, routers/switches setup, and hardware maintenance.

---

## Free Student Success Suite (Career Tools)

### 1. Career Blueprint (`/tools/career-blueprint`)
An AI-assisted tool that evaluates a student's education, current skill level, and career aspirations, creating a custom step-by-step roadmap to achieve their desired role (e.g. Fullstack Developer, UI/UX Designer, Financial Accountant).

### 2. ATS Resume Analyzer (`/tools/ats-analyzer`)
A free scanner that evaluates technical resumes against target job descriptions, checking for keyword density, formatting issues, section hierarchy, and ATS compatibility.

### 3. AI Resume Builder (`/tools/resume-builder`)
A clean markdown-powered resume builder allowing students to generate ATS-friendly, professional resumes with formatted typography.

### 4. Nagaland Tech Salary Insights (`/tools/salary-insights`)
A localized salary benchmark tool displaying real compensation insights for technical and digital roles across Dimapur, Kohima, and the wider Northeast region.

### 5. Interactive Study Planner (`/tools/study-planner`)
An intelligent study scheduler helping students balance course assignments, project milestones, and exam revisions.
